newsitem.title: USA: Sun Microsystems to buy Diba Inc.
newsitem.headline: Sun Microsystems to buy Diba Inc.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire all of the outstanding shares of capital stock of Diba Inc.
The terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
Diba, which supplies the information appliance industry, will become a new business unit at Sun, the Consumer Technologies Group, within the existing microelectronics division.

Sun said this business group will work with consumer electronics companies and manufacturers to help build Java-enabled products such as Internet-enabled TVs, Internet-enabled set top and satellite boxes, and smart phones.

"By leveraging the Java software platform and Java-enabled microprocessors with Diba's experience in assembling technology components into complete solutions, Sun hopes to enable OEMs to take advantage of the market's vast potential sooner rather than later," said Scott McNealy, chairman, chief executive and president of Sun.
Diba, which employs 79 people, is based in Menlo Park, Calif.
